summary: A one-designer Readymag page for a quirky lockdown-era grotesque, dark throughout: a scattered collage of designed objects (book cover, shop widget, subway sign, sticker), then a dense specimen sheet (metrics, character lines, ligature GIFs, size waterfall, hover glyph grid) beside a running joke chart, and an uncut last page with a photo carousel, a one-slider tester and a giant 'Get Regular' pill whose sales go to the Ukrainian Red Cross.

instances.look: Near-black page with two small white lines at the top ('Today is a Tuesday' left, 'Isolation Grotesque is a typeface' at centre) and a staggered two-column scatter of objects set in the font: an orange 'Grid systems / Raster systeme' book cover, a black shop widget (S M L XL, ADD TO BAG), a camera shutter dial, a 'Times Sq–42 St Station' subway sign, a 'Similar Times' T-shirt, a keyboard and a 'SERIFEN? NEIN DANKE' sticker
instances.ux: No nav and no big name: the weekday is filled in live by JavaScript (a lockdown joke); props are images with Readymag hover animations; the scatter runs ~2.5 screens before the intro paragraph
instances.learn: Let the hero be a scatter of familiar design objects (Müller-Brockmann cover, subway sign, shop UI) re-set in the font, each a joke about where a grotesque usually lives; a live 'Today is a <weekday>' line adds a human touch for free

reconstruction.layout: Full width 1440, ~2800px tall, background #131313. Top line at y≈20: two 16px labels at x=20 and x=720. Objects alternate left (x≈70–540) and right (x≈800–1360) in a zig-zag, ~250px vertical gap: book cover 460×680, shop card 545×330 (radius ~16px), shutter dial ⌀360, subway sign 515×380, T-shirt ~560 wide, keyboard 690×290, sticker ⌀290
reconstruction.typography: Labels ~16px Isolation Grotesque Regular white; props carry the font at various sizes inside images (book title ~44px, sign 'Times Sq–42 St Station' ~50px, button caps ~14px); no display-size name anywhere in the hero
reconstruction.behaviour: span#weekday set from new Date().getDay(); props are pictures with on-hover animation (Readymag has-onhover-animation); white loader for ~2s on load
reconstruction.content: Design-culture artefacts: Grid Systems book cover, e-commerce size picker, camera dial, NYC subway sign, 'Similar Times' T-shirt, keyboard, anti-serif protest sticker
reconstruction.assets: 12 SVG/PNG illustrations of the objects with type converted to outlines

instances.look: At the bottom of the collage, a 7-line white paragraph: 'Isolation Grotesque is designed to be the antidote to boring sans-serif typefaces commonly found in user interfaces…'
instances.learn: Make the claim concrete (tall x-height, legible small, characterful large) and date it ('drawn in early 2020 and refined throughout the lockdowns')

reconstruction.layout: Left column from x≈60, ~880px wide, ~240px tall, at the end of the 2800px collage block
reconstruction.typography: ~24px Isolation Grotesque Regular, leading ~1.25, white, ragged right
reconstruction.content: Positioning copy: antidote to boring UI sans serifs; large x-height; drawn in 2020 lockdowns; 'coming to font managers near you'

instances.look: 'Qq&' in white at ~500px on four hairline metric lines labelled 700, 540, 0 and −180 in tiny grey numerals
instances.learn: Label the metric lines in font units (cap 700, x-height 540): the numbers prove the 'tall x-height' claim without prose

reconstruction.layout: Left column x≈72–940, ~420px tall; hairlines across the column at ascender, x-height, baseline, descender with unit labels at the far left
reconstruction.typography: Glyphs ~500px Isolation Grotesque Regular white; labels ~9px grey
reconstruction.content: Q, q and & (cap, descender and a showy ampersand)

instances.look: A specimen-sheet stack in white on black: A–Z and a–z set as running lines (~50px), a row of 16 arrows, 0–9 with circled and negative-circled numerals and €$¥£, big fractions ½ ¼ ⅛ and a 1/123456 arbitrary fraction, an outlined 'R', a © and a giant 'Aa' beside an outlined, rotated ß
instances.ux: static; interleaved with the ligature GIF cards (separate instance)
instances.learn: Mix filled and outline-only glyphs at different scales so a plain character listing reads as a composed poster

reconstruction.layout: Left column x≈60–1000, ~2000px tall; two-column zones where a 430×370 white GIF card sits beside a category (alphabet right of card 1, numerals left of card 2, 'Aa' right of card 3); big outlined R ~400px behind the fractions

reconstruction.content: Alphabet, arrows, numerals, enclosed numerals, currency, fractions

instances.look: Three white rounded cards on the black sheet, each with a tiny 'ligatures' label and iOS-style switch in the top-right corner and one sample at ~150px: '|->', '{10', '(i', with the input string in small type at the bottom
instances.ux: Each card is a looping GIF: the switch flips on and off and the sample changes between plain characters and the ligature or case-sensitive form (arrow ligature, raised brackets)
instances.learn: Fake the toggle in a looping animation: the visitor sees the before/after without clicking, and the switch tells them it is an optional feature

reconstruction.layout: Cards ~430×370px, radius ~10px, white; switch label top-right (12px); sample centred; raw input string centred near the bottom (10px)
reconstruction.typography: Sample ~150px Isolation Grotesque Regular black; labels ~11px
reconstruction.behaviour: Three looping GIFs toggling ligatures (dlig/hlig/case-style forms) on and off
reconstruction.assets: 3 GIF animations (could be rebuilt live with font-feature-settings toggled on a timer)

instances.look: 'Isolation' repeated at six shrinking sizes (~200 → 32px); from the fifth line the word grows into German compounds with the extra part in grey ('Isolations|bescheid', 'Isolations|bescheidsformularvorlage'); then the same Fort Boyard paragraph at labelled sizes 'Regular · 28px', '20px', '14px', '11px' in columns
instances.learn: As the size drops, lengthen the word (German compounds) so every line keeps roughly the same width: the waterfall stays a solid block and the joke rewards reading

reconstruction.layout: Left column x≈60–1000; display lines stacked tight (~1.0 leading); then 28px paragraph full column (~900px), then two columns (~440px each) for 20px and 14px, 11px under the 14px one; small grey size label above each paragraph
reconstruction.typography: Display 'Isolation' at ~200, 165, 130, 97, 64, 32px Isolation Grotesque Regular white, grey (#525252) for the compound tail; paragraphs Regular at 28/20/14/11px, leading ~1.25; labels ~10px grey
reconstruction.content: German compound jokes on the name; Wikipedia-style paragraph about Fort Boyard (fortification and TV game show) with numbers and accented French names

instances.look: 249 glyphs in a 15-column grid of square cells with hairline grey borders, white glyphs on black, in encoding-ish order (A Á Â … to arrows)
instances.ux: Hovering a cell pops it: scale 1.25 with a springy cubic-bezier, white fill, black glyph
instances.learn: A springy hover zoom (overshooting cubic-bezier) makes a plain grid feel physical at no cost

reconstruction.layout: Left column 0–1000px, 15 columns of ~67px square cells, 1px #2f2f2f borders; ~17 rows (~1150px)
reconstruction.typography: Glyphs ~22px Isolation Grotesque Regular white, centred
reconstruction.behaviour: .glyphs div { transition: all .3s cubic-bezier(0.68,-0.6,0.32,1.6) } :hover { transform: scale(1.25); background:#fff; color:#000; border-color: transparent }
reconstruction.content: Full character set: Latin with diacritics, numerals, enclosed numerals, fractions, punctuation, currency, maths, arrows

instances.variantDefinition: A sticky or fixed element that shows how far the visitor has scrolled (a bar, a dial, or a dot travelling along a drawn curve), often dressed as a themed figure or joke; it has no links.
instances.look: Sticky in the right gutter for the whole specimen sheet: a white hairline exponential curve with a dot that climbs it as you scroll, captioned 'Fig (a) · Time spent looking at exponential graphs' (a 2020 pandemic joke); hidden on mobile
